content.text:
1. High: the new settings-only path writes to `.entire/settings.json` in repos that were intentionally configured as local-only. `configure`/`enable` now enter `updateStrategyOptions()` whenever `settings.IsSetUpAny(ctx)` is true, which includes the “only `settings.local.json` exists” case, but `determineSettingsTarget()` falls back to project settings when `settings.json` is absent. In a repo created with `entire enable --local`, running `entire configure --checkpoint-remote ...` will unexpectedly create and populate committed project config. See [setup.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup.go#L78), [setup.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup.go#L376), [settings.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go#L377).

2. Medium: `updateStrategyOptions()` loads the merged view of project+local settings and then writes that whole merged object back to a single file. Because `Load()` applies local overrides on top of project settings and `Save`/`SaveLocal` serialize the entire struct, `--project` can copy local-only overrides into committed config, and local writes can pin project defaults into `settings.local.json`. That breaks the layering model the rest of the settings code relies on. See [setup.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup.go#L79), [settings.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go#L104), [settings.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/settings/settings.go#L523).

Assumption: I’m treating the current local/project split as intentional, based on the existing behavior and tests around preserving file targeting for settings updates, e.g. [setup_test.go](/Users/soph/Work/entire/devenv/cli/cmd/entire/cli/setup_test.go#L300).

No other clear regressions stood out in this patch. I did not run tests.
